recognize_zh: 紅血球大小相當一致，但散在幾個淚滴狀／梨形紅血球、少數標靶細胞（中央有一圈色素環），蒼白區輕度擴大而不像缺鐵那樣明顯大小不一，屬於地中海型貧血帶因者常見的輕度異形紅血球表現。
features: Red cells of relatively uniform size with mild hypochromia (slightly enlarged central pallor)
Mild poikilocytosis with scattered teardrop/pear-shaped cells and occasional elliptocytes
Occasional target cells, including one with a distinct ring of hemoglobin within the pallor
A few stomatocyte-like cells with slit-like central pallor
No basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells or fragments seen; white cells not present in this field, limiting size assessment
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells of fairly uniform size with mild hypochromia and mild poikilocytosis, including scattered teardrop and pear-shaped cells, occasional target cells and a few stomatocyte-like forms. Basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells and schistocytes are not seen. No leukocyte is present in the field to gauge red cell size, so microcytosis must be confirmed by the MCV. The findings are nonspecific but compatible with thalassemia trait; beta-thalassemia trait is supported by a high RBC count with low MCV and increased HbA2 on HPLC.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows marked anisocytosis, conspicuous hypochromia and pencil cells with a low ferritin, rather than uniform cells with target and teardrop forms.
Smear morphology overlaps completely; alpha-thalassemia trait has a normal HbA2 and is confirmed by alpha-globin gene analysis.
HbE and HbC traits also show target cells and microcytosis but are distinguished by a variant hemoglobin peak on HPLC or electrophoresis.
Myelophthisic processes show more numerous teardrop cells with nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes (leukoerythroblastosis), absent here.
